home.h1: Repair, maintenance and sale of lifting equipment on the French Riviera
home.intro: Dantès repairs, refurbishes and sells lifting equipment for professionals on the French Riviera and across the South of France: aerial work platforms, truck-mounted cranes and mini crawler cranes. Based in Carros, we work on site with a fully equipped workshop van, or take your machines into our workshop.
home.servicesTitle: Three ways to get your equipment moving again

services.title: On-site maintenance
services.text: We have a fully equipped workshop van for all on-site repair services, covering Alpes-Maritimes (06), Alpes-de-Haute-Provence (04), Var (83) and Bouches-du-Rhône (13). We make every effort to provide you with prompt on-site service, regardless of access.

services.title: New or used equipment sales
services.text: We offer new and high-quality used lifting equipment, carefully selected to meet your specific needs. Our team is at your disposal to advise and assist you in choosing the most suitable equipment for your projects.

services.title: Workshop refurbishment
services.text: We can take in and refurbish all types of equipment in our workshop, regardless of the age of the machine or the nature of the repair: combustion or electric engines, electrics, hydraulics and metal fabrication.

home.zoneText: From Carros, we cover the Riviera and its hinterland as far as Marseille.
home.brandsText: Mini cranes, aerial platforms, truck-mounted cranes: recognised manufacturers, new and used.
home.ctaText: Call us or describe the fault: we prepare the job before we set off.

onsite.lead: Dantès offers a complete on-site maintenance service for all types of lifting equipment, with a fast and effective intervention right where your machine stands. With a fully equipped workshop vehicle, our team works across Alpes-Maritimes (06), Alpes-de-Haute-Provence (04), Var (83) and Bouches-du-Rhône (13).

assets.title: Responsiveness
assets.text: Fast response from a mobile workshop truck, for effective support on site.

assets.title: Technical versatility
assets.text: Full diagnostics and repairs covering: mechanics (combustion and electric), hydraulic and electrical systems, metal fabrication, welding and spare parts.

assets.title: Personal support
assets.text: Technical advice tailored to each need, whether it is a breakdown, preventive maintenance or choosing replacement equipment.

steps.title: First contact
steps.text: You call us or send a request through our website.

steps.title: Remote pre-assessment
steps.text: We review the information and identify the problem so the job is prepared efficiently.

steps.title: Fast scheduling and cost estimate
steps.text: The job is scheduled according to your urgency (immediate repair or preventive maintenance planning).

steps.title: Mobile intervention
steps.text: Our technicians arrive in an equipped workshop truck to carry out diagnostics, repairs or adjustments on site.

steps.title: Full report
steps.text: You receive a report describing the work done, the condition of the equipment and recommendations for future maintenance.

steps.title: Post-intervention follow-up
steps.text: Optional periodic maintenance contract to anticipate breakdowns and extend the life of your equipment.

onsite.ctaTitle: Need a fast intervention or a quote?
onsite.ctaText: Contact us today for technical support that fits your schedule.

workshop.lead: At Dantès, our workshop is specially equipped to bring your lifting and handling equipment back to life, whether it is old or suffering from severe faults. We work on all types of equipment, whatever the age of the machine.
possible: Machining or replacement of defective parts
Mechanical, electrical, hydraulic or metal fabrication restoration
workshop.possibleText: We aim to restore not only function, but also the reliability and lifespan of the equipment.
workshop.processTitle: From arrival to return to service

steps.title: Equipment arrival
steps.text: We receive the machine at the workshop and record its condition and the symptoms reported.

steps.title: Technical assessment
steps.text: We identify the components to rework or replace and give you an estimate before any major work.

steps.title: Full workshop refurbishment
steps.text: Dismantling, machining or replacement of parts, mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and fabrication repairs, then reassembly.

steps.title: Validation tests
steps.text: Complete functional check: lifting loads, precise operation, safety, hydraulics, electrics.

steps.title: Detailed report
steps.text: A clear report with the work done, the condition of parts, recommendations and a quote for future maintenance.
